armour._doc: Four slots. Poise = base.poise + worn poise. Incoming damage is cut by the summed absorption for its kind (absorb_kind maps a packet kind to an absorption key), capped at absorb_cap. Total worn weight picks the roll tier: under light_under is light, over heavy_over is heavy, else medium (= player.roll as-is). roll_tiers override player.roll keys.

lock._doc: Lock-on. Acquire within range/cone with line of sight; a horizontal flick (mouse px accumulated inside flick_window s) or the right stick past stick_threshold switches to the nearest target on that side, scored on screen by angle_weight*|angle from the horizontal| + distance_weight*(screen distance / viewport width). Breaks on the lock button, beyond break_range, or after los_grace s without line of sight.

render._doc: shadow_distance: the sun's shadow reach in metres per graphics-quality tier (Low, High, Ultra). prop_ranges: [small_max_m, small_range_m, mid_max_m, mid_range_m]; kit props whose largest side is at most small_max_m stop drawing past small_range_m, up to mid_max_m past mid_range_m; larger kit always draws.

balance._doc: The range between lit and shaded ground (EnvRig._bal): per state, factors on the sun, the ambient, the sky fill, the bloom, the contrast and the SSAO, applied on top of every area's own profile. Below 1 on sun and above 1 on ambient narrows the range.

exposure._doc: Real-GPU exposure (EnvRig._apply_exposure), tier 2 only: auto-exposure on/off (off: under a software tier-2 run it brightened the Kettle vista further; try it on hardware before turning it on) and its limits in ISO around 100 (80..140 is about -0.3 to +0.5 stop), its speed and target scale; the factor on SSAO intensity where SSIL and SDFGI also occlude; where bloom starts and how much; SDFGI energy.

interior._doc: The ambient a house interior takes in place of the sky's (HouseProbe): colour and energy per world state, how far inside the walls it fades in (metres), and the strength of the room's own reflections.

body_push._doc: Soft separation between the Bearer and the frost-taken (player._part_from_foes). Outside a roll or backstep the Bearer is eased out of each foe's push radius (enemies.json push_r, else max(col_r, 0.9*hurt_r)) by at most max_step metres a physics tick. Rolls still pass through.

endings._doc: COLDWELL.md 10. Seconds into each ending at which its beats fall; the credits' pace. Nothing here is spoken.

outsong._cam: [right, up, back] from the Bearer as he faces the spring. Both ends stand in the gap of the ring: anywhere else that far back is inside a standing stone.

intro._doc: docs/lore/INTRO.md. The opening, once, before the Strand on a new journey. Each beat: its card, how long it holds, the camera (absolute [x,y,z] from/to/look, or [right, up, ahead] about the Bearer kneeling at 'hearth'), and what it turns ('wave' rime|thaw from 'origin' or the hearth, after 'wave_at' seconds; 'coal' sets the coal on the stone). 'place' changes are cut through coal. Nothing it turns is kept.

beats.text: In Rimeholt a hearth is not let out while one of its household lives. When the last one dies, the neighbours let it go on purpose, with a song.
The song is the Outsong. It is sung the night after a burial, in masks, so the dead cannot find the face they loved best, and go.
One midsummer a coughing sickness came up the fjords. House by house, nobody could bear to start the song. They kept their dead by the fire one more night, then one more.
The warmth of the world went into keeping them. The frost came in the middle of summer and has not left.
Those who would not let go are the Holdfasts. They have grown into what they kept hold of. To release one is to sing the song they could not, for their dead.
You were sent down the coast as a child, before the sickness, with a coal from the hearth in a horn. You kept it fed. It is the last live coal in Rimeholt.
Set the coal on a cold hearthstone and the stone remembers its last warm evening, and whoever sat at it. Leave the stone cold and the place is as the frost left it.
Every river in Rimeholt starts at one spring under the ice, the Coldwell. The one who stopped the singing first is up there.
When you reach it you can sing, and the spring comes, and the remembered evening is gone for good. Or you can keep the coal, and the evening, and the winter.
